verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents STT model choice and multilingual STT/TTS selection (docs-10), configurable LLM provider selection (open_ai, anthropic, aws_bedrock, google, groq, nvidia — docs-9/22), and conversation-context controls (docs-11/23), giving developers real control over transcription and language model pipeline within the Voice Agent stack. However, there is no explicit documentation of 'key terms'/keyword-boosting or custom vocabulary support specifically within the Voice Agent API, and no independent/hands-on benchmark confirming real-time transcription accuracy claims. missing for 10: explicit key-term/keyword-boost support in Voice Agent context, independent accuracy benchmarks/corroboration for real-time transcription performance.
